identity: Black-Green midrange where land recursion (Groundskeeper, Grapple with the Past, Eccentric Farmer) doubles as card advantage through The Gitrog Monster and Wrenn and Seven, with Tireless Tracker and Cultivator Colossus as top-end payoffs and a self-mill graveyard package (Splinterfright, Moldgraf Millipede, Spider Spawning) as a secondary win condition.
